image_description: A close-up photograph of a vintage comic book cover titled 'Spectacular Spider-Man'. The cover features a central illustration of three orange, robotic-looking spider-creatures with multiple legs and large eyes, seemingly fused or stacked together. The background is dark and textured. There is significant text at the top (title) and bottom (credits/logos), as well as a vertical strip of text on the left spine area. The image has a slightly grainy, low-resolution quality typical of older photography or scanning.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the far left vertical strip is nonsensical and garbled, resembling AI-generated pseudo-text rather than legible print. The small text blocks at the bottom right also appear slightly distorted and illegible upon close inspection, lacking the sharpness of real printed text.

The textures on the orange robots are overly smooth and plastic-like, lacking the fine line work, ink strokes, or halftone patterns typically found in comic book illustrations. They look more like 3D renders pasted onto a 2D background.

The way the three figures merge or stack is anatomically and mechanically ambiguous. Limbs seem to emerge from unclear points, and the connection between the top figure and the two below lacks clear structural logic, appearing slightly melted or fused.
